    AI Overview
    The 130th Boston Marathon is scheduled for
    Monday, April 20, 2026, on Patriots' Day. The race, managed by the Boston Athletic Association (B.A.A.), is a premier road racing event with a cut-off time of 4 minutes and 34 seconds (4:34) applied to the 24,362 accepted qualifiers. The race starts with wheelchair divisions at 9:02 a.m. and features a rolling start beginning at 10:00 a.m.. 
    Key 2026 Boston Marathon Details: 
    • Event Date: Monday, April 20, 2026.
    • Qualified Participants: 24,362 runners were accepted from 33,249 applicants.
    • Cut-off Time: 4:34 (Applicants had to run this much faster than their age-standard qualifying time)
      .
    • Start Times (ET):
      • 9:02 a.m. - Men's Wheelchair
      • 9:05 a.m. - Women's Wheelchair
      • 9:37 a.m. - Professional Men
      • 9:45 a.m. - Professional Women
      • 10:00 a.m. - Rolling Start
    • Course: The traditional 26.2-mile course from Hopkinton to Boston's Copley Square.
    • Event Sponsor: The event is presented by Bank of America. 
    Important Information for 2026 Participants: 
    • Road Closures: Expect closures as early as 8:00 a.m. along the entire length of the course, particularly impacting Beacon Street.
    • Merchandise: The 2026 commemorative jackets and merchandise often release online in early December prior to the race.
    • Hotel Accommodations: Options near the finish line in Copley Square can be booked through official partners like Marathon Tours & Travel. 
    For runners interested in future races, qualification standards are listed on the B.A.A. official website.

    Is it true only 1% of people run a marathon?
